summary: Prerequisites for the network examples: Ansible 2.10+, compatible devices, basic YAML, Jinja2, Linux CLI and switch/router configuration knowledge.
questions: What do I need to follow the Ansible network examples?

answer_card.title: Network examples prerequisites
answer_card.answer_md:
- Ansible 2.10 or higher
- Ansible-compatible network devices
- Basic YAML and Jinja2 templating
- Basic Linux CLI
- Basic switch and router configuration knowledge
